title: Telemetry incident response policy (legacy)
text: Legacy telemetry incidents had a sixteen-business-hour initial response target. This version was superseded and must not be used for current servicing decisions.

title: Telemetry incident response policy — Standard tier
text: For an active Standard subscription to PRD-TELEMETRY, the initial response target for a service-impacting telemetry incident is eight business hours. Escalation review occurs after two consecutive failed synchronization windows.

title: Telemetry incident response policy — Premium tier
text: For an active Premium subscription to PRD-TELEMETRY, the initial response target for a service-impacting telemetry incident is two clock hours. Escalation review occurs after three consecutive degraded synchronization windows or any confirmed data-loss event.

title: Telemetry incident response policy — proposed revision
text: Draft proposal for a one-hour telemetry response target. This document is unapproved and is not authoritative.

title: Diagnosing delayed telemetry batches
text: Delayed telemetry batches can follow repeated connector retries. Support should compare synchronization-window timestamps, confirm whether batches eventually arrive, and distinguish latency from data loss before recommending reindexing.

title: Tier 2 investigation note for CASE-4821
text: CASE-4821 was escalated after three consecutive synchronization windows exceeded the latency baseline. Tier 2 found connector retries but no evidence of data loss. A controlled index rebuild is scheduled for the next maintenance window.

title: Customer call transcript for CASE-4821
text: Maya reported that telemetry appeared forty to sixty minutes late during three evening synchronization windows. She confirmed that the delayed readings eventually appeared and asked for an explanation before the next reporting cycle.

title: Investigation note for CASE-4824
text: CASE-4824 tracks intermittent telemetry export latency for Northstar Bikes. One synchronization window failed and the following retry completed normally; the Standard-tier escalation threshold has not been reached.

title: Updating a billing contact
text: A billing-contact update requires a verified account administrator. Support may explain the verification steps but cannot change the billing contact from this servicing assistant.

title: Customer follow-up note for CASE-4823
text: The CASE-4823 dashboard refresh issue could not be reproduced. Support requested the mobile application version and a timestamp from Priya before continuing the investigation.
